name: seo-audit
description: Audit a website through 11 SEO lenses (indexing and crawl, technical, migration risk, clusters and cannibalization, content, internal links, CTR and snippets, structured data, AI search visibility, backlinks, brand vs non-brand) using Search Console, GA4 and PageSpeed read-only, and deliver a visual report for people plus a hands-off Markdown brief (tasks, exact targets, acceptance criteria) for AI agents.
